done_when: forge read rewrites every path under the checkout in the reader's output to a repo-root path (/docs/..., which GitHub resolves from the repo root), before writing the notes, for both readers; a test feeds a stub reader an absolute path and finds only the repo-root path in the notes

findings.body: The suffix match stops at whitespace, leaving Windows separators after spaces untouched. For checkout `C:\work\repo`, the quoted citation `"C:\work\repo\docs\design notes\a.md"` becomes `"/docs/design notes\a.md"`, rather than `/docs/design notes/a.md`. This fails the repo-root path requirement for valid directory names on a supported platform (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:22`). Normalize the complete quoted path, and extend the stub-reader test with a directory containing spaces; its current inputs only exercise space-free suffixes.
findings.title: Not done: forge read rewrites every path under the checkout to a repo-root path for both readers

why: forge read writes the cold reader's output as is, and the Codex reader cites files by this machine's absolute path, so the committed read notes carry /Users/... paths that are wrong for everyone else
